categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Has the Mempool label and modifies mempool ordering logic in src/txmempool.cpp and src/txgraph.cpp.
categories.rationale: Reduces mempool lock contention by replacing O(N log N) sorting with an O(N) chunk index traversal in CTxMemPool::GetSortedScoreWithTopology(). Benchmarks demonstrate significant performance improvements under lock, with getrawmempool execution dropping from 99 ms to 24 ms for 60k transactions.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Benchmark, unit, and fuzz test additions in src/test/ and src/bench/ merely accompany the mempool optimization rather than modifying shared test infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Not a member of test infrastructure; the added benchmark and tests are specific to the mempool changes.
